summary: Sync sent each request body as one Full<Bytes> frame, causing Windows IoSlice construction to panic when its length exceeded u32::MAX. The fix introduces ChunkedBody with zero-copy frames capped at 4 MiB and an exact size hint. Blocked: the added regression test directly constructs ChunkedBody, which does not exist in the parent. Removing that implementation verbatim prevents the unchanged test from compiling; restoring only the worker's Full<Bytes> usage leaves the tested ChunkedBody unchanged. Altering its frame-splitting logic would invent parent code. No valid verbatim reversal with a detecting unchanged test was established. The regression test belongs to package turso and requires its sync feature. No builds or tests were run.
